source.historical: User-supplied 2024 campus overview and nine-row route schematic; reviewed label transcription only

definitions.catalog: Same route identity/number only. Common / historical, common / current, and common / union have distinct denominators. No renaming inferred.
definitions.confirmedCoverage: Unique normalized historical landmarks with at least one full-label or reviewed synonym match / all unique normalized historical landmarks on that route. Semantic coverage, not bus-stop or geometry accuracy.
definitions.plausibleCoverageUpperBound: Same denominator, adding explicitly reviewed compound-component or broader-area candidates. A liberal semantic ceiling, not verified stop coverage or a statistical confidence interval.
definitions.duplicates: Normalize before deduplicating historical labels; retain first occurrence for order. Repeated endpoint/intermediate labels remain recorded but do not increase the coverage denominator.
definitions.order: LCS of first-occurrence matched historical landmarks against current source-index positions / matched unique historical landmark count, separately forward and reverse. Geometry uses actual visits; sourceArray is diagnostic. All candidate positions are retained; multi-candidate LCS is a maximum feasible alignment, not a unique alignment. Unmatched landmarks are excluded ONLY from the order denominator. No rotation, inferred closing edge or invented return visits.
definitions.noCounterpart: Historical 9 has no current catalog counterpart. Coverage and order are null (N/A), not zero; snapshot absence does not establish withdrawal.
definitions.aggregation: Micro coverage sums numerators/denominators across eight comparable route rows; the same landmark on two different routes counts once per route. Historical 9 excluded. Macro coverage averages the eight route percentages before rounding.
definitions.limitations: Historical schematic has no georeferenced polyline, complete stop inventory, verified operation direction, or current loop closure. Pixel shape, actual-stop accuracy and operational direction cannot be measured.
